fixes.title: Phantom Game (BKN @ BKN)
fixes.description: The same team (BKN) appeared on both sides of a game, generating nonsensical predictions and corrupted value bets. Root cause: Bovada API returned a game event with a malformed description that caused both home and away to resolve to the same abbreviation.
fix: In fetch_todays_games_bovada(): after parsing 'away @ home', skip the game if away_team == home_team.
In build_predictions_output(), nba_api games loop: after resolving abbreviations, skip with log message if home_abbrev == away_abbrev.
In build_predictions_output(), odds-only games loop: same guard added before appending to all_games.
fixes.data_fix: Removed 1 phantom game (BKN @ BKN) and 2 phantom value bets from data/nba-agent/latest-picks.json

fixes.title: Odds Sanity Gate (model vs market divergence)
fixes.description: For some games, the model probability and market implied probability diverged by >50 percentage points (e.g. SAS @ MIL: model=83.5% vs market=9.1%), indicating team code mismatch or corrupted odds data. These would generate wildly inflated Kelly bets on bogus edges.
fix: Added a sanity gate in build_predictions_output() after computing home_implied.
Gate conditions: market_implied must be in [0.10, 0.90] AND abs(model_prob - market_implied) <= 0.50.
If gate fails: bet_side = SANITY_FAIL, kelly_stake = 0, best_odds = {}, game gets a sanity_note field. Spread and total data still recorded.
SA -> SAS team normalization already present in betting_agent.py TEAM_MAP (line 73).
fixes.notes: The SAS @ MIL case in predictions-today.json (2026-03-28) had market_implied=0.0909 and model=0.8351 (gap=0.7442). This would now be caught by the sanity gate.

fixes.title: Data Validation — latest-picks.json cleanup
fixes.description: The 2026-03-31 picks file contained 1 phantom game (BKN @ BKN) and 2 phantom value bets referencing BKN @ BKN spread and moneyline bets.
fix: Removed phantom game entry: home=BKN, away=BKN.
Removed 2 phantom value bets: {BKN @ BKN, spread, BKN +17.5} and {BKN @ BKN, moneyline, BKN ML}.
Added validation metadata block to the JSON.

sa_to_sas.note: SA -> SAS normalization was already present in betting_agent.py TEAM_MAP. The odds analyzer uses NBA_TEAMS dict in power_ratings.py which uses SAS directly.
